personality_one_liner: A highly functional, trust-inspiring university credential platform that prioritizes instant access and operational clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for ID elements; tight grouping for history logs and analytics.

do's: Use on the digital ID card overlay for liveness depth
Sticky header backgrounds when logs scroll
dont's: Do not use on dense admin tables or log lists

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Secure authentication into the student or admin portal.

states.error: Toast or inline alert indicating invalid credentials

screens.layout: Centered form with university logo/text at top, student/admin toggle, email/password inputs, and a sticky login button. Subtle blurred building image background with a gradient scrim.

screens.name: DigitalID
screens.purpose: Primary student view for campus access via NFC tap or QR code.

states.empty: Illustration indicating missing enrollment data with contact admin CTA
states.error: Error card with a retry button to fetch ID credentials

screens.layout: Bento box style or focused centered layout. Hero section is the digital card with student photo, name, ID number, and a subtle shifting gradient (liveness indicator). Large 'Tap to Enter' (NFC) primary action button below, and a secondary action to 'Show QR Code'.

screens.name: NFCVerificationScreen
screens.purpose: Simulated reader screen that shows the result of an NFC tap.

states.loading: Pulsing NFC icon awaiting simulated tap
states.error: Access Denied screen (red/error styling) with brief reason (e.g., Not enrolled)

screens.layout: Full-screen modal. Default state is 'Ready to Tap'. Upon tap action, transitions to large Success (Green check) or Denied (Red cross) icon with building name and timestamp.

screens.name: History
screens.purpose: Log of recent campus access attempts for the student.

states.empty: Illustration of empty corridor and 'No access history yet.'

screens.layout: Sticky header. Flat list of access records showing building name, timestamp, and status (granted/denied). Grouped by date.

screens.name: Profile
screens.purpose: Student settings and credential revocation (lost device).
screens.layout: Profile header with avatar. List of actions: Revoke ID (Danger action), Enrollment status, App Settings, Logout.

screens.name: AdminDashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of campus access analytics and alerts.
screens.layout: Analytics charts (e.g., building usage over time), recent critical denied access alerts. Card-based metric summaries.

screens.name: AdminStudents
screens.layout: Sticky search bar and filter chips. List of students. Tapping a student opens a bottom sheet to Issue/Revoke digital ID and manage building permissions.

login_background.alt: Modern university building facade used as abstract background

empty_history.alt: Empty minimal university corridor for no history state

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor icons consistently across the app. Do not use emoji in the UI.
For the digital ID card liveness indicator, use react-native-reanimated to create a subtle shifting gradient behind the card data, or a subtle pulsing border.
Implement a bottom sheet (@gorhom/bottom-sheet) for QR code fallback display and admin issuance/revocation tasks to maintain context without full screen switches.
The login background must have a vertical top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so that the login form remains perfectly legible.
Admin and Student roles should be cleanly separated in logic, but present a unified design language built on the Navy, White, and Light Grey palette.
For the simulated NFC reader, ensure the transition between 'Ready', 'Processing', and 'Granted/Denied' feels native and responsive with haptic feedback.
Use standard spacing rhythms (e.g., lg for container padding, md for gaps) and ensure touch targets are at least 44x44pt.
Ensure Loading, Empty, and Error states are properly implemented for data-fetching screens.
